purpose: Ingest, curate, audit, and route OKF knowledge updates while keeping unapproved material outside trusted retrieval.

minimum_nodes.name: Receive ingest request
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Accept transcript, upload metadata, or source text envelope from MeIDs.

minimum_nodes.name: Validate OKF intake policy
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Require source_type, title/content, target_state, evidence policy, and CRUD append-only policy.

minimum_nodes.name: Create pending OKF concept
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Generate Markdown/YAML concept draft with review_state=pending_review.

minimum_nodes.name: Store source evidence
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Return concept_path, evidence_path, transcript_path, and crud_log_path for repo sync review.

minimum_nodes.name: Trigger Graph Curator
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Create candidate graph edges only; never promote them to accepted without review.

minimum_nodes.name: Defer vector refresh
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Return deferred vector_refresh unless the concept is approved or selected-pending under policy.

minimum_nodes.name: Return contract response
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Return completed, approval_required, or failed envelope matching the fixture shape.

approval_boundary: May create pending-review concepts and candidate graph edges. Must not approve concepts, accepted graph edges, or trusted vector refresh without human review.
